name: inherit
note: Upgrade inheritance on machine swaps. 3D5A (mode < 2000 or 500) reaches 800AAD28, which takes the predecessor from the fixed table D_800CA3A0 (not from the script's old-machine word), saves its five body levels and every weapon's level, and 800AA8F4 writes weapon levels back only through the global old->new weapon table D_800CB5E8. 3D6C first puts every body item and every weapon of the old machine on the same level, so after the swap a weapon at that level was carried over and a weapon at 0 was not. A: Layzner -> New Layzner, where 1070 flamethrower and 1072 grenade launcher have no table entry although New Layzner has 1057/1059 of the same names. B: Altron -> Altron Custom (the same call the EW upgrade makes), where 470 Dragon Fire has no entry although Custom has 1291 Dragon Fire. C: Albion -> Argama, where 219 anti-air laser maps to 210 anti-air machine gun rather than 211 anti-air laser. D: mode 500 leaves the old machine in the roster; if the pilot is later registered onto the existing successor again, the predecessor is still found and its levels are written over the successor's.
